method: Offline AST scan of 144 saved JavaScript bundles: only fixed generic categories of identifier spellings, object literal names and cooccurrence within lexical function scopes. Source was not executed.
privacy: Numeric counts and original explanation only. No literal names from source, URLs, values, message contents, account identifiers, code excerpts or raw assets.
limits: Fixed-name identifiers are not recovered schema fields; minified, vendor and unexecuted code can contribute.
Object and function cooccurrence cannot establish true dataflow or selected conversation graph.
Actual message parenthood, branch selection, submit lifecycle, streaming grammar and response persistence remain unobserved.
Only an authorized disposable test session can provide runtime confirmation.

dom_footprint.method: Offline HTML parse of one captured rendered page. Generic action groups counted only in selected semantic attributes, without copying their values.
dom_footprint.caveat: Counts are matched label occurrences, not distinct working capabilities. Actions, click handlers and successful outcomes were not recorded. Unmatched words do not imply absent controls.
